profile.belief:
I have always been captivated by movies and stories. I started as a child actor when I was 9, but quickly found a passion for the creatives behind the camera. There’s something that pulls me to the industry and I can’t explain it. 
I decided I was going to pursue biomedical engineering in college, but two weeks before I left I received a time capsule letter from myself when I was in my first ever video class in middle school. I wrote about how by graduation I hoped to be doing so many big movie things and that’s when I realized I almost gave up on a dream. That letter reminded me just how badly I want to be apart of the industry, and since then I have never given up on my dream. I went through school and received a dual degree in math and film, as my parents wanted me to get a “real” degree but I was determined to do film as well.
profile.working_on: I would love to direct and do the cinematography for feature films. There is something about creating a visual story that calls to me.
